findings.claim: When note X is saved linking back to Markdown note Y, Y's pre-origin row (Y, X) is still deleted even if Y's file still links X, so a live backlink stays unlisted until Y is next saved, while the commit removes the only known-issues entry describing that behavior.
findings.impact: With mutual links recorded before origins existed, X's page shows Y only under Links from this file and omits Links to this file, and Y's page omits Links from this file. Nothing tells the user why, and known-issues.md no longer lets them recognize it. Saving Y restores the row. This is limited to pre-origin rows and heals itself.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/markdown_relations.py:167 subtracts target_ids from waiting_for_source, so the row falls through to db.delete at :181. backend/tests/test_relation_ownership.py:226-233 seeds source.md with 'See [[target]]' and pins only the (target, source) row. docs/process/reviews/fix-pre-origin-link-survives-save/decisions.md step 4 records that Y still says [[X]] and X's page does not list Y under Links to until Y is next saved. The diff deletes the known-issues entry, and docs/developer-guide/known-issues.md:6-9 and :22-23 say reachable defects are listed and a row is removed when fixed or when it is decided not to fix it. The test comment at test_relation_ownership.py:222 says Y is listed 'once on X's page for each direction', but the assertion at :233 allows one direction only.
findings.repro: not_reproduced by this reviewer (read-only). Traced from the code and matches decisions.md step 4: Y contains [[X]], set (Y, X) origin to NULL, save X with [[Y]], then GET /api/files/X/relations returns only (Y, outgoing, markdown).

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariants are declared. The narrowed behavior is deliberate and pinned by a test, but it is still a user-visible missing backlink that is now undocumented.

findings.proposed_fix: Keep a narrowed known-issues entry for the link-back case, and delete the misleading sentence in the test comment at test_relation_ownership.py:222.

Traced as behaving the way the tests pin it: Markdown Y's pre-origin row survives X's save when X does not link Y; Y's save marks or removes it; a non-Markdown Y's row is still settled by X's save; a trashed Y's row is kept and listed again on restore.
potential_unspecified_behavior: A kept null-origin row is displayed under Related files, not Links to this file, until Y is saved (groupRelations.ts:10).
A missing Y (missing_since set) counts as a Markdown source because _markdown_source_ids applies no active filter, so its row waits as a trashed note's row does. No test pins this.
A pre-origin (Y, X) row where Markdown Y never linked X, such as one written by an addon before origins existed, now also waits for Y's save rather than going on X's save.
A pre-origin seed row from a Markdown source to a note (source, note) now survives the note's uncited save and waits for the source's save. The existing seed tests use only a video source.
regression_risks: If Y is edited outside the app and no longer links X, the row remains listed: no scanner path calling sync_markdown_file_relations was found in backend/app, and X's save no longer clears it. It stays until Y is saved through the app.

A lingering (Y, X) pre-origin row occupies uq_file_relations_a_b_kind for longer, so POST /api/internal/file_relations for the same pair and kind returns 409 for longer (backend/app/routers/internal.py:622).
The new File query and lazy import run on a save only when an incoming null-origin row exists, so the cost is limited to upgraded data.
test_coverage: Mutations traced by reading, not run. Removing '- target_ids' at markdown_relations.py:167 should fail test_legacy_incoming_link_is_replaced_when_the_target_links_back. Removing the _is_markdown_file filter at :115 should fail test_legacy_seed_the_note_does_not_cite_is_removed. Adding an active-file filter to the query at :114 should fail test_legacy_incoming_link_from_trashed_markdown_is_kept.

The 'relation.file_id_b == file_id' check at markdown_relations.py:171 is redundant: a row whose file_id_a is in waiting_for_source cannot have file_id_a == file_id, so removing it is an equivalent mutant rather than a test gap.
No test seeds both pre-origin directions (X, Y) and (Y, X) together; by reading, the code handles this correctly.
No test exercises the waiting branch through drives.py:881 or markdown_image_import.py:458; they call the same function.
No test covers a missing (missing_since) Y, or a Markdown source identified only by mime type.
not_verified: No tests or mutations were run; the tools were read-only and all behavior was traced by reading.
